body.prompt: Original animation source sheet for Battle of Gods. FIRST reference is exact King identity/body palette/proportions; SECOND is his canonical enormous greatsword (motivates force, but DO NOT draw any weapon). Transparent background. Crisp outlined pixel art, complete connected head/scarf/navy torso/brown gloves/short legs/boots. EXACT FOUR ROWS of EIGHT widely separated full-body cels in a1536x1024 sheet. Same King standing height/body/head size throughout, no growth during spin/jump, no labels, no shadows, no slash or fragments. Closed gloves visibly attached to intact sleeves; distinct dark outlines between gloves and chest. Rows are chronological actions, each cel complete and crop-safe. Row1 FRONT SLASH: 1 relaxed right-facing entry, 2 feet plant and hips coil, 3 closed right glove raises into upper-front load, 4 shoulders brace at a high-forward glove, 5 explosive right-facing extension at chest height, 6 low-forward follow-through with knees braced, 7 low loaded right-facing stance ready for return, 8 deeper low-forward return anticipation. This stroke follows a huge120-degree arc across the FRONT, not an overhead chop into the floor. Row2 RETURN SLASH: 1 low-forward loaded continuation, 2 chest twists back and knees push, 3 low-forward wrist anticipation, 4 right glove pulls forward and upward, 5 explosive rising return across the FRONT with torso counterweight, 6 right glove high-forward, 7 weight settles at shoulder, 8 hips preload a spin. Keep gaze right throughout this return. Row3 FULL BODY SPIN: exact same King, 1 right-facing loaded stance, 2 three-quarter toward camera, 3 DOWN/front-facing with arms extended at waist, 4 three-quarter LEFT, 5 LEFT-facing side view with connected sword glove extended, 6 three-quarter back-left, 7 UP/back view with red scarf visible at nape and hair-only back head, 8 RIGHT-facing again completing one360-degree turn. Full-body rotation with one boot pivot and scarf motion. No giant silhouette, no unrelated armor, no tilted detached heads. Row4 JUMP STRIKE: 1 right-facing crouch with right glove raised, 2 deep crouch both feet together loading, 3 short airborne right-facing pose legs tucked close and raised right glove, 4 airborne glove above/front shoulder preparing overhead strike, 5 explosive forward-down extended glove while knees lower, 6 powerful landing crouch with glove forward at waist, 7 recoil absorbed by bent knees, 8 normal right-facing carry stance. Draw bodies only, gloves imply huge one-hand sword. Every head stays connected through the red scarf/neck. The air pose should not get physically larger than standing poses. EXACT4x8 sprite layout with sufficient transparent gaps. Original artwork, no copying characters from other games.

slash.prompt: Create original transparent pixel-art sword animation VFX for Battle of Gods. The reference provides ONLY the white/silver/cold-gray sharp raster style. NEW1536x1536 sheet: EXACTLY FOUR ROWS with FOUR isolated transparent cells per row, generous margins. No character, no weapons, no backgrounds, no shadows, no labels, no yellow/gold, no vector outlines or perfectly uniform circles. Each row is four chronological keys: leading trace, huge contact ribbon, full follow-through ribbon, disappearing shards. SAME pivot and SAME scale across all four keys in each row. Row1 FRONT120-DEGREE SWEEP: imagine pivot at LEFT-center of each cell, a120-degree front arc from upper-right through far RIGHT to lower-right. Row2 RETURN120-DEGREE SWEEP: same front arc lower-right to far RIGHT to upper-right, opposite leading/sharp tail chronology.
